# Voidblade v__VERSION__

**Slash through dimensions.** A dimensional utility tool in obsidian and neon violet: a Rift Anchor to jump back to places you saved, and a Void Magnet that pulls loot and XP to you.

## What's new in v__VERSION__

__CHANGES__

## Download

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| **`voidblade-__VERSION__.jar`** | The mod. Put it in your `mods` folder. |

**Requirements:** Minecraft `26.3`, [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) `0.19+`, [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api), Java 25.

## Install in 30 seconds

1. Install Fabric for Minecraft 26.3.
2. Drop **Fabric API** and **voidblade-__VERSION__.jar** into `.minecraft/mods`.
3. Launch the game. Craft the Voidblade (see the README) or `/give @s voidblade:voidblade`.

## Controls

| Action | Result |
|---|---|
| Right-click | Return to your Rift Anchor |
| Sneak + right-click | Save the anchor where you stand |
| Hold in either hand | Void Magnet pulls items and XP within 8 blocks (crouch to pause) |
